name: spotkit
title_zh: 同一套 SVG 插画，喂功能描述就出图
tagline_zh: 给产品文档、空状态页配图时，不用再翻素材库碰运气。输入一段功能描述或截图，输出同一视觉语言下的极简抽象插画。
tagline_en: Stop hunting stock art for docs and empty states. Feed it a feature spec or screenshot; get matching minimal.
desc_en: Generate minimal, abstract, UI-inspired illustrations for software product features — as deterministic SVG. Use when asked for a feature illustration, product illustration, spot illustration, empty-state graphic, feature-card artwork, docs or developer-portal illustration, or a consistent illustration set/family for a product. why_zh: 它把插画当代码产物：同一输入永远同一输出，能进 Git 评审，能随产品迭代重生成。
why_en: Treats illustration as code: same input, same SVG, diffable in Git, regenerable as your product evolves. Not AI roulette—a.
limit_zh: 只认英文功能描述或截图，中文输入需先自行翻译。输出为抽象极简风，不适合拟物、写实或复杂叙事场景。单张生成。
limit_en: English feature specs or screenshots only (translate Chinese first). Output is abstract/minimal—no photorealism or narrative scenes. Generates one.
title_en: Deterministic SVG illustrations from feature descriptions
